verification_categories_derived_from_spe: MAC frame structure: preamble (7×0x55) + SFD (0xD5) + DA(6) + SA(6) + Type/Length(2) + Payload + Pad + FCS(4) constructed correctly for sizes 64, 100, 256, 1518, 1522 (VLAN), 9000 (jumbo, if supported) bytes.

FCS engine: bit-true CRC-32 with polynomial 0x04C11DB7, init 0xFFFFFFFF, final XOR 0xFFFFFFFF, LSB-first. Verify on test vector ASCII '123456789' → CRC-32 = 0xCBF43926 and on captured Wireshark frames.
FCS error injection: flip 1 / 2 / N bits in received frame; MAC must increment FCS-error counter and discard.
Runt frame (< 64 B excluding preamble + SFD): MAC must discard.
Giant frame (> 1518 B untagged / > 1522 B VLAN): MAC must discard unless jumbo support is enabled.
IFG enforcement: ≥ 96 BT between back-to-back transmits at 10 / 100 / 1000 Mb/s.
Auto-pad: short payloads zero-padded to 46 B by MAC TX FSM.
EtherType disambiguation: ≥ 0x0600 → type, ≤ 0x05DC → length; reserved range 0x05DD-0x05FF behaviour.
MAC Address recognition: own unicast, broadcast (FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF), programmed multicasts, promiscuous mode.
MII signal timing: TXD / TX_EN / TX_ER setup ≥ 10 ns + hold ≥ 0 ns vs TX_CLK; RX clock-to-output ≤ 25 ns; duty cycle 35-65 % for TX_CLK and RX_CLK.
MII TX_EN waveform: assert with first preamble nibble; remain asserted continuously through final FCS nibble; de-assert before next TX_CLK.
MII RX_DV waveform: assert no later than SFD; de-assert after final FCS nibble.
MII TX_ER mid-frame: PHY emits invalid symbol on medium (verifiable on the far end).
MII RX_ER mid-frame: MAC discards in-progress frame.
False Carrier indication: RX_DV = 0, RX_ER = 1, RXD = 0x1110; MAC increments counter without delivering data.
GMII at 125 MHz: GTX_CLK driven by MAC; byte-wide TXD / RXD; same TX_EN / TX_ER / RX_DV / RX_ER semantics scaled to bytes.
RGMII at 125 MHz DDR: TXD[3:0] and RXD[3:0] sampled on both edges; TX_CTL encoding (TX_EN on rising, TX_ERR XOR TX_EN on falling).
CSMA/CD half-duplex: defer on CRS; collide on COL during transmit → emit 32-bit JAM + backoff; Late Collision (after 512 BT) → abort + counter increment.
Truncated-binary-exponential backoff: uniform-random(0, 2^min(N,10)) × 512 BT slots; cap at 1024 slots after attempt 10.
Excessive Collisions abort: after 16 retries, frame discarded.
Full-duplex operation: no CSMA/CD; independent simultaneous TX + RX; CRS / COL ignored.
PAUSE frame: receive valid PAUSE (DA = 01:80:C2:00:00:01, EtherType 0x8808, opcode 0x0001) → MAC stalls TX for N × 512 BT.
PAUSE with quanta = 0: MAC immediately resumes TX.
MDIO C22 Read: PRE(32) + ST(01) + OP(10) + PHYAD(5) + REGAD(5) + TA(Z0) + DATA(16); PHY drives data MSB-first.
MDIO C22 Write: PRE(32) + ST(01) + OP(01) + PHYAD(5) + REGAD(5) + TA(10) + DATA(16); STA drives data MSB-first.
MDIO C22 preamble suppression: when BMSR bit 1.6 = 1 in both ends, STA may omit the 32-bit preamble.
MDIO C45 Address + Data two-cycle protocol: address cycle (OP=00) writes indirect address; data cycle (OP=01 / 11 / 10) accesses register.
MDIO C45 Post-Increment Read (OP=10): internal address auto-increments.
BMCR Reset (0.15): self-clearing; complete within 0.5 s; all registers restored to default.
BMCR Loopback (0.14): TX_EN → RX_DV within 512 BT; no medium activity.
BMCR Isolate (0.10): MII outputs high-Z; MDIO responsive.
BMCR Power Down (0.11): no spurious MII activity; MDIO responsive; exit within 0.5 s.
BMCR Collision Test (0.7): TX_EN → COL within 512 BT in half-duplex.
BMSR Link Status (1.2) latching-low: stays 0 after link-down until re-read.
BMSR AutoNeg Complete (1.5): set once Base Page resolution succeeds.
BMSR Remote Fault (1.4) and Jabber (1.1): latching-high; clear on read.
AutoNeg Base Page exchange: ANAR ↔ ANLPAR; ACK detection; three identical Base Pages.
AutoNeg priority resolution: 1000-FD > 1000-HD > 100-T2-FD > 100-TX-FD > 100-T2-HD > 100-T4 > 100-TX-HD > 10-FD > 10-HD.
AutoNeg PAUSE / Asym-PAUSE resolution per Annex 28B Table 28B-3.
AutoNeg Parallel Detection: link partner without FLP → bring up in 10BASE-T or 100BASE-TX half-duplex.
AutoNeg Restart (BMCR 0.9): self-clearing; FSM returns to AN_ABILITY_DETECT.
AutoNeg Next Page: exchange Message + Unformatted pages for 1000BASE-T MASTER/SLAVE resolution.
VLAN tag parse: 0x8100 TPID + TCI fields (PCP[3] + DEI[1] + VID[12]); max frame 1522 B; deliver PCP + VID to upper layer.
fields.notes: IEEE Std 802.3-2005 does NOT include a formal verification testbench. The categories above are derived from Clauses 4 (MAC), 21-22 (MII), 28 (AutoNeg), 31 (MAC Control / PAUSE), 35 (GMII), 40 (1000BASE-T), and 45 (MDIO MMD). UNH-IOL and the Ethernet Alliance run interop and conformance test programs; PMD electrical conformance is per the relevant PMD clause.
